name: 3/8-16 stud with nut under and over the bar (positive)

mounts.note: origin = stud axis at the top of the bar plate (bar_hole outlet); plate sits between the under nut and the lock washer + nut over it

accepts.note: 0.65 in of thread above the nut; the SAE adapter threads on with 0.60 in

source: estimate: standard 3/8-16 hex nut 0.56 AF x 0.33, lock washer 0.06 (as nut-38); 0.06 in of stud below the under nut
notes: ESTIMATE: stainless 3/8-16 stud. Nut under the bar, lock washer + nut over it, 0.65 in of thread left for the SAE adapter. Plate thickness 3 mm.
